summary: Wrote a 9-phase, 15-hour implementation plan adopting the research phase's two-layer ruling: verdict acquisition stays per-surface at the skill layer, while enforcement is anchored inside scripts/state-write.sh (new exit 5) rather than a Write|Edit PreToolUse hook, which cannot observe the Bash-mediated state.json writes at all. Settled the two decisions the record deferred to planning: the shared matcher is named scripts/audit-task-proposals.sh (superseding the declared audit-open-tasks.sh path), and the verdict vocabulary is a fixed eight-value enum that keeps open-side and closed-side matches distinct, cites closed records by project_name plus discharging artifact, and emits an explicit scope-blind degradation. Also verified two things research left open: commands/errors.md has no active_projects write site at all, so the state-write.sh migration set is two files, not three.

artifacts.summary: 9 phases across 5 dependency waves: contract document and file_scope extension, raw-writer migration onto state-write.sh, the shared audit-task-proposals.sh matcher, the regression fixture suite, the state-write.sh audit-evidence gate, Component 4b in the creation standard, the Bash-matcher backstop hook, per-surface wiring, and a final deploy-plus-full-gate phase.
